relationships.rationale: The shared validation record and the field-level Required option represent one authored requirement. field.required is the canonical authored contract; validation.required remains discovery evidence and must not become a second independent control.

The shared repeatability family is the richer canonical primitive because clone defaults, bounds, storage mode, add-button text and empty-start behavior already depend on it. field.cloneable is retained as a market-facing discovery alias.
Sortable Values and Sortable Clones represent one repeatability sorting behavior. The shared behavior record is canonical because it belongs to the repeatability family.
field.rest_schema is the authored field/API schema configuration. rest.schema represents the resolved native/effective REST schema emitted after type, registration and provider rules are applied.
field.escape_html is the authored output-escaping policy. value.escape represents the resolved value-pipeline stage and must not surface as a second configuration control.
field.format_value is the authored formatting policy. value.formatted represents the resolved formatted-output state produced by that policy and any registered field/provider behavior.
